original_forecast.resolution_rule: Success if S&P 500 Information Technology sector ranks among top three GICS sectors by total return from Aug. 7 close through Sep. 8 close.
rationale: Weak labor data creates easing pressure.
Inflation/geopolitical risk remains large enough to prevent a narrow forecast.
Cross-asset confirmation is more informative than SPX alone.
surprising_if: Outcome materially contradicts the linked causal story.

resolution.source: PortfoliosLab dividend-adjusted one-month returns for State Street sector ETFs, last updated Sep. 8, 2026.
resolution.source_layer_note: The frozen rule names S&P GICS sector total returns. The accessible resolution source is a dividend-adjusted sector-ETF proxy rather than a direct S&P sector-index total-return table. Because at least three corresponding sector ETFs outperformed XLK by clear margins, the proxy is sufficient to establish the categorical top-three failure while preserving this source-layer limitation. Aug. 8, 2026 was a Saturday, so the displayed one-month window aligns operationally with the Aug. 7 trading close start.
resolution.audit_note: Original forecast content is preserved without hindsight alteration. Information Technology was not top three. No model probability was assigned to the ranking, so no proper probability score is manufactured; the equal-sector 3/11 benchmark remains contextual rather than being retrofitted into a model probability.
